row.name: Rigel Pharmaceuticals Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=10 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.32 tightness=0.79 base_volume_vs_leg=0.69 base_volume_vs_avg=0.76
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 4.3% vs its 20-SMA, 1.1% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The single most decisive visible flaw is the RE FAIL: the burst bar's range of 3.4% is only 83% of the largest bar in the prior five sessions, meaning the signal day did not produce genuine range expansion — a core Bonde requirement. The base shaded region (Oct 12–23) shows several wide, overlapping red and green bars with bodies spanning roughly 2–3 points, which is loose for a 10-session consolidation at this price level, and the tightness proxy of 0.79 sits just inside the ordinary C pass but outside the A+ threshold. Volume is also below the 50-session average (0.78x) and ranks only 38th of the last 60 sessions, so the burst lacks the volume conviction that supports follow-through.
claude.key_risk: RE failure combined with a loose base and below-average volume means the burst bar is not a true expansion and the consolidation may not have reset supply enough for a clean move.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above 50.49 (base high) with no pullback, or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below 49.00 on elevated volume.
